content: The floor looks super clean. Did you call the cleaning company?
Nope. My foot is broken. I stay at home. So I did it myself.
With a broken foot? Was that a good idea?
You could have called Brenda. She would have done it for you.
I'm not asking your little sister to clean my floors, Dave. Anyway, it wasn't as hard as you think. I have been using a Roomba recently.
Oh, that cleaning robot? I'm jealous, Sandra. I wanted one, but I didn't have 500 extra dollars.
I know. They're so expensive. I got mine from my boss when I was Employee of the Year two years ago.
